info.name: IRoute - Dynamic Auto Shipment + POD Branching Flow
info.description:
# Dynamic Auto Shipment + POD Branching (v5)

## Mobile app workflow (matches Job Detail stepper)
**Pickup → Loading → In Transit → Delivery → POD**

Postman executes `allowed_actions` dynamically — action codes (OA-xxxx or A1-A10) come from your Action Master.

## Document mapping (IRoute_Operational_Logic.html §2.4)
| Mobile UI | Backend actions |
| Pickup | A2 Pickup Arrival |
| Loading | A3 Start Loading + A4 Confirm Loaded (Auto Shipment ON) |
| In Transit | A5 Depart In Transit |
| Delivery | A6 Delivery Arrival |
| POD | A7 Upload POD (+ A7H Hard Copy if Hard POD) |

## Run order
1. **00** full preship (if actions exist) OR **00B** if shipment already exists
2. **02** mobile workflow cycles until `ready_for_pod=true`
3. **03** POD capture + upload → **04** branch → **05B/05A** → **06** close

item.name: 00 - Auto Shipment ON (Pickup + Loading milestones → shipment birth)
item.description: Maps to mobile UI Pickup + Loading steps (doc A2–A4). Requires Start Job (A1) plus Pickup, Loading, Confirm Loaded with Auto Shipment ON on Confirm Loaded only. If booking has no allowed_actions, cycles skip — use folder 00B.

exec: console.warn('Preship cycles 04-07 will SKIP — run folder 00B then 02.');

00B - Shipment phase start (OA-0003+ no preshipment)
item.description: Use when only shipment-phase actions exist (OA-0003 In Transit through OA-0006 POD). Shipment must already exist in portal. Sets skip_preshipment=true and workflow_path=shipment_only.

exec: if (sid) { irouteEnvSet('shipment_id', sid); irouteEnvSet('job_id', sid); irouteEnvSet('job_type', 'shipment'); }

item.name: 02 - Mobile Job Workflow (Pickup → Delivery, dynamic)
item.description: Mirrors mobile app stepper: Pickup → Loading → In Transit → Delivery → (POD in folder 03). Each cycle runs the next allowed_action from Job Detail. Works on booking (early milestones) or shipment job after auto birth. Stops before POD when ready_for_pod=true.

item.name: 03 - Digital POD capture + OA-0006 upload
item.description: Runs when ready_for_pod=true. Sets hard_pod_required for folder 04/05B branching.

item.name: 05A - Digital POD only (optional post-POD action)
item.description: Skipped when hard_pod_required=true. Unload step optional — OA-0005 may already run in folder 02.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('execute_action_code')) console.log('No post-POD action — skip 14A (unload already done in 02).');

item.name: 05B - Hard POD (digital POD then DN hard copy confirm)
item.description: Run when hard_pod_required=true after folder 03 POD upload. Hard copy uses hard_copy_action_code (OA-0006 or separate A7H row). Post-Hard-POD execute (17B) is optional if unload already done in folder 02.

exec: var confirmed = pages.map(function (p) { return { page_id: p.page_id, document_id: p.document_id, line_no: p.line_no || 1, confirmed: true }; });
